Run the Zig tests of a package

Source: R/test-zig.R
test_zig.Rd

Runs zig build test for the client package: the test blocks reached from src/rzig/src/tests.zig are compiled for the host and run without R. tests.zig imports the files whose tests should run, for example test { _ = @import("kernels.zig"); }; files that use the rzig module need R and cannot run there, so numerical kernels are best kept in files of plain Zig. The package folder receives no build output.

Usage

test_zig(path)

Arguments

path

Path to a package previously initialized with use_rzig().

Value

An object of class rzig_zig_tests: a list with ok, failed (the names of failed tests), seconds and log, invisibly. A failure also signals a warning.

Examples

# \donttest{
if (isTRUE(find_zig(required = FALSE)$supported)) {
  package_path <- tempfile("rzig-tests-", tmpdir = tempdir())
  dir.create(package_path)
  writeLines(c("Package: examplepkg", "Version: 0.0.1"),
    file.path(package_path, "DESCRIPTION"))
  use_rzig(package_path)
  writeLines(c("const std = @import(\"std\");", "test \"addition\" {",
    "    try std.testing.expectEqual(4, 2 + 2);", "}"),
    file.path(package_path, "src", "rzig", "src", "tests.zig"))
  test_zig(package_path)
  unlink(package_path, recursive = TRUE)
}
#> Generated RZig bindings for examplepkg: 1 exported function
#> Created RZig scaffold for package examplepkg
# }
